items.event_time_ist: Announced Oct 19, 2026; Macon rally is Sat Oct 24, 2026
items.summary: Georgia's Republican governor nominee Rick Jackson will skip President Trump's rally in Macon this Saturday (Oct 24), opting to campaign in suburban Atlanta/Cherokee County instead; his campaign frames it as a 'force multiplier' turnout strategy. The move comes after Jackson joined Trump onstage at the Oct 16 Dalton rally, and as polls show Trump deeply underwater in Georgia (Civiqs: 33% approval, lowest of his second term; AJC: 55% disapprove). Senate nominee Mike Collins, by contrast, WILL attend the Macon rally with Trump. Jackson vs Keisha Lance Bottoms remains a virtual tie (AJC/UGA SPIA: Jackson 46, Bottoms 45).
items.title: Georgia GOP gov nominee Rick Jackson to skip Trump's Macon rally

items.summary: Barack Obama will headline the 'United for Georgia Rally' on Wednesday Oct 28 in Atlanta (4-7 PM EDT) with Sen. Jon Ossoff and gubernatorial nominee Keisha Lance Bottoms, in a final early-voting push before the Oct 30 deadline. The rally was first reported by the AJC (Oct 18) and confirmed by Obama in an X post. Ossoff and Bottoms held a joint rally in Cobb County on Oct 17. Kamala Harris also comes to Georgia late this month: she keynotes the Fulton Forward Dinner on Oct 30 and will stump with Ossoff beforehand. Trump counterprograms with his Macon rally Oct 24 (Jackson skipping, Collins attending).
items.title: Obama to headline 'United for Georgia' rally in Atlanta Oct 28 for Ossoff, Bottoms
